lvl_A1_desc: Everyday basics: introductions, family, food and drink, shopping, times and numbers, directions.
lvl_A2_desc: Your day and routine, travel and transport, simple work and study talk, the doctor and health, telling what happened (Perfekt).
lvl_B1_desc: Giving and defending your opinion, telling experiences, work and customers, phone calls, job interviews, problems and solutions.
lvl_B2_desc: Discussions and general topics: technology, society, culture, the economy, the news, professional topics — speaking fluently and debating.
lvl_B2_note: Close to fluent on general topics

about_text: I'm Mohammed Emad. On YouTube I share explanations and my experiences learning languages – and vlogs from my life with German. I built Sprich Deutsch so Arabic speakers have a clear path from A1 to B2: topics to talk about, listening, reading, writing, grammar – and a place to study with friends.
